title: BPF-Ext: Safely Extending the eBPF Compilation Pipeline with Native Operations (artifact, atc26-ae-2)
description:
Artifact for the accepted ATC 2026 paper "BPF-Ext: Safely Extending the eBPF Compilation Pipeline with Native Operations" (accepted paper #1160).

The artifact contains the Make-backed benchmark harness, the bpfopt bytecode optimizer and stock-kernel userspace shim, the KOperation native-operation kernel modules, and the Lean 4 semantic-proof suite. The evaluator guide is docs/atc26-artifact-evaluation.md; artifact status, dependencies, commands per claim, expected outputs, raw-result locations, and honest boundaries are documented there.

Repository-original material is MIT licensed; third-party and vendored components keep their own licenses, listed with exact pinned revisions in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
notes: Artifact-evaluation release for ACM ATC 2026. No DOI is asserted in this file; the DOI is assigned by Zenodo on deposit. The paper's reported x86 Xeon and ARM64 AWS figures were not re-measured while preparing this artifact.
